unpairedVersions.scope: The original step-one binding/action lesson is distinct from the later antigen-recognition lesson and has been read in full, rather than being treated as unchanged. No thematic match closes another original concept page.

index: Recognition, priming, travel, state, escape, checkpoint regulation and clinical outcome are separate bridges; the learning map is not a mandated protocol.
Late-brake/already-present T-cell wording, pattern-to-cause implication, prognostic-versus-treatment-selection and unbounded no-marker statements need source qualification.
Personal routing section is excluded anonymously from public content, while retaining section identity.
01-how-a-t-cell-sees-a-cancer-cell: Specify conventional alpha-beta peptide-HLA recognition and CD8/class-I versus CD4/class-II; no universal all-T-cell wording.

Class-I proteasome/TAP/ER/B2M route, typically 8-10 amino acids, up to six distinct inherited classical products with diploid/heterozygosity conditions; prediction, display, recognition and killing differ.
Antigen table, Ademuyiwa 16%/168, Parkhurst 62/75,83%,1.6%,99%, and fictional 60*.016=.96 require distinct sample/screen denominators.
One-principal-receptor and neoantigen lowest-risk assertions require qualification for dual receptors and cross-reactivity, without introducing unsupported rates.
02-start-a-response: Display is not naive priming; collection, soluble antigen/node resident cells and migrating dendritic cells can use different routes.
Cross-presentation of acquired external antigen differs from intracellular RNA delivery/expression; no universal vaccine route.
Three-signal framework is conditional, not literal switches; subset and state/maturation differ; no single count proves useful priming.
03-reach-the-tumor: The node-blood-vessel-stroma-nest journey is a common route, not all T cells in all tumours.
Chemokine, vessel adhesion, matrix and macrophage mechanisms retain Harlin, Mikucki, Salmon, Mariathasan, Hammerl and Gruosso model/population scopes.
Hot/excluded/desert distribution cannot uniquely identify the causal barrier; fictional A/B pattern and 40% stromal score do not diagnose it.
Unbounded no-approved-exclusion-drug statement is not adopted without jurisdiction/date/mechanism scope.
04-read-an-immune-map: Location, marker identity, sampled region, denominator, specificity, function and treatment prediction differ.
TLS organization/maturity and native lymph-node architecture are distinct from cell count; macrophage location and suppressive myeloid function need their own evidence.
Loi2148 and OS HR.84 per10percentage-point sTIL increase are prognostic associations; eight/eight/two symbolic fields are not an sTIL score.
05-t-cell-states: Count, clonotype, specificity, state, division and killing remain separate; anergy/exhaustion/senescence are not interchangeable.
Henson/Pereira human subset and assay boundaries, FOXP3-only insufficiency, Im chronic-virus versus Miller tumour models and Yost sampling-versus-migration require primary checks.
Tpex and clonal replacement can coexist; TCF1/PD1 are not universal predictors; adult thymic decline has no fixed stop birthday.
06-find-the-failed-step: Conventional TCR display, surface CAR recognition, target/access/function/safety routes differ; bypass is not guaranteed rescue.
Interferon induction versus deleted machinery and JAK loss versus recognition loss retain the selected melanoma model conditions.
TAP/proteasome defects do not automatically remove all class-I presentation; scope B2M/classical-HLA claims and HLA LOH allele versus whole-haplotype loss.
Montesion83,644/17% is commercial pan-cancer detection scope; NK missing-self balance and dual immune/drug failure exercise need separate measurements.
07-what-checkpoint-inhibitors-change: PD1 regulation and CTLA4 priming overlap in biology; blockade does not install a receptor or repair a deletion, but indirect presentation/trafficking changes cannot be ruled out universally.
KEYNOTE522 1174 total,602 interim;64.8/51.2 pCR versus label63.0/55.6 all-cohort,36mo84.5/76.8 HR.63,60mo86.6/81.7; timing components not isolated.
KEYNOTE355847,CPS>=10 23.0/16.1 HR.73,CPS>=1 HR.86 are overlapping analysis populations. No significant test is not proof of absent individual benefit.
Label indication/PDL1 selection differs by stage;2799 monotherapy hypothyroid8%,adrenal.8%,52220% discontinuation/cortisol require exact label version and section reads.
08-measure-a-response: Tissue, blood/PBMC, dissociation and segmentation preserve different information; merged cell boundaries can misassign markers.
Complete six-stage evidence table and worked enriched blood clone/tumour overlap/peptide response do not assign a full receptor or natural cancer killing.
Flow/ICS gate, spots/input, relative repertoire frequency, cells/area and target-death denominators differ.
Epitope spreading/immunodominance need target-specific assays; ctDNA decline plus immune change does not identify a cause.
09-read-a-tcr-sequencing-report: Preserve all seven report sections, DNA/RNA input, chain/CDR3/gene-segment definition, sampling depth, relative frequencies, diversity, comparisons and annotations.
VDJdb matches are leads; read Robins two-adult diversity and Pogorelyy three twin-pair 600-1700 claims before adopting how validation was performed.
Fictional .1%->2% is20fold share, not20fold cells; stable3->3.1% and nondetection do not determine specificity or body-wide absence.

Separate bulk beta identity and separately stimulated mixture cannot identify one paired receptor; matching target, cross-reactivity, natural presentation, function and clinical benefit remain separate.
original-1-ligands: Read the entire original-only binding/action lesson: same molecular address can support activation, blocking, effector recruitment or payload delivery; binding strength is not a growth-control result.
Retain all three fictional package rows and the receptor-agonism/antagonism example.
HER2 direct-ligand absence and HER2-HER3 structural source PMID34759323 must be resolved before adopting; NCBI/NCI sources have not yet been read in this cohort.
